words.root_logic: abs-（离开、撇开）+ tain（tenere 握住）→ 把伸出去的手往回握住，不去碰
words.origin: 拉丁语 abstinere：abs-（离开）+ tenere（握住）——「把手握回来，不伸向那样东西」
words.native_definition: to choose not to do or take something, especially by deliberate self-restraint
words.core_concept: holding your own hand back from something within reach – 东西就在手边，自己把手握住不伸过去
words.core_image: 手已经伸到盘子边上，又收回来攥在膝上，一口没动
examples: He decided to abstain from alcohol completely.
Three members abstained in the final vote.
semantic_expansions: 戒除：想要的东西就在手边，手自己收回来不去拿
弃权：该举手的那一刻手不抬起来，既不赞成也不反对
collocations: abstain from sth / doing sth —— 戒除、不做某事，from 不可省
abstain in a vote —— 投票时弃权，用 in 不用 from
